# sedulous

> Persevering, persistent, diligent in one's efforts

> paying attention to details; diligent


## Example

- *An avid numismatist, Harold sedulously amassed a collection of coins from over 100 countries--an endeavor that took over fifteen years, and to five continents. self-*
